subject: Kai D2 Results — 13/14 confirmed, Q8 missing (bug), 38 min, massive improvement
body:
FA — Kai completed Winter Final Diagnostic 2. Results from screenshots (Send to Dad still broken — Marcus sent manually).

SCORE: 13/14 confirmed correct. Q8 missing from screenshots — bug prevented capture. If Q8 correct: 14/15 (93%). If wrong: 13/15 (87%).

TIME: 38:33 countup. Down from 70:52 on D1. Kai is moving faster and more confidently.

WRONG: Q4 (W2.c) — g(x)=2sqrt(x-1)+3. Got parent and domain right (x>=1). Entered range=0 instead of 3. The vertical stretch coefficient confused him on the range start. Exact gap we identified.

KEY WINS vs D1:
- Q10 (W4.a): Wrong on D1, correct on D2. Parabola opens UP, vertex in Q3. He got all 5 parts.
- Q11 (W4.h): Vertex+point form — profile gap, never tested before D2. Got it cold.
- Q12 (W5.a): AC method a!=1 — profile explicit weakness. Got it cold.
- Q15 (W6.c): Required radical simplification sqrt(28)=2sqrt(7). Got it.
- Q7 (W3.d): Negative fractional base, x=-3/2. Got it.

REMAINING WEAKNESS: W2.c range with vertical stretch coefficient. One-line fix for tomorrow.

BUG REPORT: Q8 was not captured in any screenshot. Likely a scroll/rendering issue in the exam UI. Send to Dad still not working — this is the second exam Marcus has had to screenshot manually. Needs fix before Tuesday final.

Exam: finals-diagnostic-2, commit aa765ad.
